Welcome To Our Federation!
Welcome from the Executive Headteacher
It is with great pride and joy that I welcome you to the Flourishing Schools Federation, comprising Northside Primary School, Queenswell Infant and Nursery School, and Queenswell Junior School, which includes Treetops (our additionally resourced provision for Cognition and Learning Difficulties and Autism).
Our federation is built on a foundation of inclusion, diversity, and aspiration. We are a multicultural, multi-faith community where every child is valued, respected, and empowered to achieve. We believe that every child has the right to flourish—academically, socially, and emotionally—and we are committed to nurturing their unique potential in a safe, supportive, and inspiring environment.
Across our three schools, we work collaboratively to provide a rich and engaging curriculum, high-quality teaching, and a culture of kindness and respect. Our dedicated staff, supportive families, and vibrant community all play a vital role in helping our children grow into confident, compassionate, and capable individuals.
Whether you are a prospective parent, a new member of staff, or a visitor, we invite you to explore our schools and discover the strength of our shared vision: Happy to Learn, Inspired to Flourish; Enjoy, Endeavour, Achieve Together
Mrs LongworthExecutive HeadteacherFlourishing Schools Federation

pageCache.pageTitle: The Flourishing Schools Federation - Welcome from the Executive Headteacher
pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Executive Headteacher
Welcome to Queenswell Infant and Nursery School, where children aged 2 to 7 begin their learning journey in a nurturing, inclusive, and inspiring environment.
At Queenswell, we live by our motto: Enjoy, Endeavour, Achieve, Together. This reflects our belief that learning should be joyful, challenging, and shared—laying the foundation for every child to flourish.
We are proud of our beautiful, green site, surrounded by nature, which provides the perfect setting for our Forest School curriculum. Here, children explore the outdoors, build resilience, and develop a deep connection with the natural world.
Our curriculum is ambitious, well-structured, and thoughtfully planned to ensure that every child achieves their full potential. As Ofsted recognised in June 2023:
“Leaders want all pupils to achieve well. They have put a well-structured curriculum in place. Leaders’ curricular thinking is ambitious. They have identified what they want pupils to learn and remember.” “Pupils behave well in lessons. Staff motivate them so they want to do well.”
We are passionate about enriching our curriculum with exciting trips and experiences that bring learning to life—whether it’s visiting museums, theatres, farms, or other inspiring places that spark curiosity and creativity.
Our school values—Respect, Determination, Humour, Compassion, Responsibility, and Equality—are woven into every aspect of school life. They help us create a warm, inclusive community where every child feels safe, valued, and ready to thrive.
We warmly welcome visits to our school. Come and see the joy of learning in action—we look forward to meeting you.
Warm regards, Mrs Longworth Executive Headteacher

pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Executive Headteacher
It is my privilege to welcome you to our Junior School—a vibrant, multicultural and multi-faith community where every child is valued and celebrated. Our motto, “Enjoy, Endeavour, Achieve Together,” reflects our commitment to creating an environment where pupils love learning, develop resilience, and succeed as part of a supportive team achieving above average expectations in the national assessments at the end of Year 6.
We live by our core values of determination, responsibility, equality, respect, compassion, and humour. These values shape our culture and guide our pupils to become confident, caring individuals who make a positive difference in the world; building even further the strengths of the Infant and Nursery School.
We are proud that Ofsted (June 2023) recognised the strength of our community, stating
“Leaders have developed a culture that is caring and welcoming. Pupils experience a strong sense of community. They enjoy learning and are kind to each other. Staff know all pupils very well and have built positive working relationships with them. Pupils are safe and happy in the school.”
We are proud of our beautiful, green site, surrounded by nature, which provides the perfect setting for our Forest School curriculum. Here, children explore the outdoors, build resilience, and develop a deep connection with the natural world.
We warmly welcome visits to our school. Come and see the joy of learning in action—we look forward to meeting you.
Warm regards, Mrs Longworth Executive Headteacher

pageCache.pageTitle: The Flourishing Schools Federation - British Values
pageCache.text:
British Values
Our children come from a wide variety of backgrounds and cultures: learning together in an atmosphere of high expectations, mutual respect, and friendship underpinned by fundamental British Values. We know and value each child in our schools and believe in ensuring that each child achieves their best, through high quality teaching and support.
Promoting British Values
In accordance with The Department for Education, we aim to actively promote fundamental British values in schools to ensure young people leave school prepared for life in modern Britain.
Pupils are encouraged to regard people of all faiths, races, and cultures with respect and tolerance and understand that while different people may hold different views about what is ‘right’ and ‘wrong’, all people living in England are subject to its law.

pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Executive Headteacher
Welcome to Northside Primary School, where we are Happy to Learn, Inspired to Flourish.
At Northside, we are proud to be a vibrant, inclusive community that celebrates diversity and nurtures every child’s potential. Our school values—Respect, Pride, Inclusion, Creativity, Challenge, and Resilience—are at the heart of everything we do. They guide our learning, shape our relationships, and help our children, from the age of 2, grow into confident, compassionate individuals.
We believe that every child deserves the opportunity to succeed and flourish. Our dedicated staff work tirelessly to create a safe, stimulating, and joyful environment where children feel happy, supported, and excited to learn.
We are delighted that our commitment to excellence was recognised by Ofsted in March 2023, who described Northside Primary School as:
“An exciting place to learn in. This is underpinned by leaders’ high expectations. They are determined that every pupil will achieve well academically. The curriculum is carefully planned and enables pupils to learn successfully in different subjects. Staff also provide a wealth of engaging curriculum days to supplement what pupils learn in lessons.”
This reflects our unwavering belief in the power of education to transform lives. We are proud of our children, our staff, and our community—and we look forward to continuing our journey together, helping every child to flourish.
Warm regards,Mrs. LongworthExecutive Headteacher

pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Executive Headteacher
Welcome to the Queenswell Schools, where we live by our motto:Enjoy, Endeavour, Achieve, Together.
Nestled on one expansive, beautiful green site surrounded by nature, our schools—Queenswell Infant and Nursery School and Queenswell Junior School—offer a unique and inspiring environment for children to grow, learn, and thrive. We are proud to include Treetops, a specialist provision supporting children with Education Health Care Plans for Cognition and Learning or Autism, ensuring that every child receives the support they need to flourish.
From the age of two, children at Queenswell benefit from a rich, inclusive education rooted in our core values:Respect, Determination, Humour, Compassion, Responsibility, and Equality.These values shape our culture and guide our commitment to nurturing confident, curious, and resilient learners.
Our dedicated staff work in partnership with families and the wider community to create a joyful, challenging, and supportive learning experience. We believe that every child deserves the opportunity to succeed and feel proud of who they are.
We warmly welcome visits to our schools—you’ll see firsthand the incredible learning, care, and creativity that make Queenswell such an amazing place. We look forward to meeting you and sharing our vision for every child to Enjoy, Endeavour, and Achieve—Together.
Warm regards,Mrs Longworth

pageCache.pageTitle: The Flourishing Schools Federation - About us
pageCache.text:
About us
The Queenswell Schools consists of two schools: Queenswell Junior School & Queenswell Infant & Nursery School. They are situated in the heart of Whetstone, Barnet, and is the only non-denominational, co-educational community school in the immediate area.
In addition, we have a Nursery for 52 part-time children and we can offer a limited number of these as full-time places available on a fee-paying basis. We offer 30 free nursery hours for those who qualify. We also have our own breakfast & after school club.
Additionally, there is an ARP (Assisted Resource Provision) on site for children with complex special needs. Entry to this is through the SEN panel. The area is well served by public transport. The school is housed in modern and well-designed buildings. Our landscaped grounds include several play areas for different age groups, environmental aware features (e.g. rainwater harvesting, solar panels, wildlife areas including a pond, meadow and recycling schemes), two sports fields and additional tennis/ netball courts.
We are privileged that our schools serve children from a rich and diverse community and we are committed to providing the very highest quality education for all our pupils.
We welcome visitors to our schools and are proud of the achievements of our children. We hope that this prospectus encourages you to visit our school and select Queenswell for your child.
Learning at Queenswell is an exciting and challenging experience for each child. There is a strong emphasis on delivering all areas of the curriculum to a high standard, so that each child experiences a broad and balanced curriculum, developing skills, knowledge and understanding in:
English, Maths, Science, History, Geography, Music, Computing, PE, RE, DT, EYFS, Phonics, Languages in Key Stage 2 (Spanish)
Our Religious Education programme aims to develop children’s knowledge and understanding of all the major faiths, promoting tolerance and respect for each other as members of our multi-cultural community, underpinned by fundamental British values.
Our committed and skilled team of teachers and support staff work together to plan and deliver creative and stimulating lessons which inspire every child. We actively foster the moral, social and physical development of each child within a safe and supportive learning environment.
The learning environment is supported by our modern, well designed facilities which include up to date technology in every classroom, landscaped grounds which include spacious play areas, quiet areas, a sports field, football pitch and additional tennis courts. For more information please contact us.
The Queenswell Schools is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people, and vulnerable adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. We operate stringent safer recruitment procedures.

Safeguarding
At the Flourishing Schools Federation, safeguarding is at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating a safe, nurturing environment where every child can learn, grow, and thrive. Our priority is to protect the welfare of all pupils by promoting a culture of vigilance, care, and respect. Through robust policies, ongoing staff training, and strong partnerships with families and external agencies, we ensure that every child feels valued and secure.
Safeguarding is everyone’s responsibility, and together we work to provide the highest standards of safety and wellbeing for our school community.
We have a team of Designated Safeguarding Leads who are trained in child protection.
